sophia.sales: Heads-up 1 -- NovaMed wants an enterprise commit. They expect ~12M tokens/day steady, short bursts up to 150 RPS for 15-20m, and ~6k concurrent chat sessions across us-east + eu-west. Need: reserved GPU plan, autoscale rules, preheat/runbook, and short copyable answers for their security questionnaire. Can eng + security deliver a draft by Wednesday EOD?

liam.solutions: Quick clarifying q's: model class (13B/16B), average token length, embeddings %. Any regulatory flags?

sophia.sales: Baseline: 16B quantized for chat, avg 320 tokens/request, embeddings ~10%. Data residency: EU PHI concerns in eu-west.

remy.infra: Back-of-envelope: with quantized 16B on our mid GPUs expect ~12 reqs/sec when cold and ~22 reqs/sec warmed at 320 tokens. Proposal per-region: reserve 8 GPUs hot in us-east, 6 in eu-west (PHI), plus global burst pool +5 GPUs. Autoscale policy: min_reserved as above, max_total = reserved + burst. Fast scale-up on token_backlog and queue_latency, step +1 GPU every 20s, max +2 per 60s. Scale-down conservative (120s). Preheat: mandatory KV warm job 20m before business windows.

claire.security: Questionnaire stub: VPC peering & private endpoints (yes), customer-managed KMS supported, audit logs (export to SIEM), SOC2 Type II available, EU data residency assured for eu-west; HSM is enterprise add-on (lead time). I'll prepare one-paragraph answers.

liam.solutions: Pricing note: target 20-28% discount vs on-demand for 12/24/36mo tiers. Show worst-case billing if burst credits exhausted. Include cost per 1000 tokens and effective cost with prefix caching.

sophia.sales: Action items: (1) remy: finalize per-region GPU counts + p95 lat (warm vs cold) and short runbook (preheat commands + checks); (2) liam: pricing rows + burst-credit model; (3) claire: questionnaire copy + docs. Deliver by Wed EOD.

ops-bot: preheat job queued: nova-commit-243900 preheat (KV warm) estimated 25m.

remy.infra: Note: p95 ~200ms warmed with reserved + burst available; cold-cache p95 >350ms. Preheat is required for meeting p95 SLO during ramp.

sophia.sales: Great, thanks team 1. I'll consolidate and send to NovaMed when artifacts are ready.
